problems.replace: In order to do this, I start with a prayer: ‘Let’s begin by connecting to the universal heart (or to my Higher Self). The universal heart (or the Higher Self) is the part of me that existed before I was born and that will exist after I am gone. It is the part of me that is not wounded, the part of me that is not caught in any roles, or families or groups. The part of me that has no identities, no ideologies, and no stories. From this place, let’s ask for what is true, kind, timely, stabilizing and useful.’
problems.with: You can start like this: ‘I begin from the universal heart. I begin from Higher Self. I begin from the part of me that belongs to life before it belongs to any wound, role, family, group, identity, ideology or story. problems.what: the guide speaks to the reader, not about clients Joel guides; and sacred language can feel borrowed from somebody else
problems.replace: Sometimes, people don’t have access to their Higher Self, or to the universal heart, or whatever language you might use that feels sacred for you. In that case, I’ll just begin by asking them to start witnessing, to notice things around them, or in their body, or to notice that they are in a younger state. The fact that they can notice is usually enough of an adult function to begin with.
problems.with: Sometimes you won’t have access to your Higher Self, or to the universal heart, or whatever language feels sacred for you, or it feels borrowed from somebody else. In that case, just begin by witnessing: notice the room, your body, and that you’re in a younger state. The fact that something in you can notice is enough of an adult function to begin with.
